structured.feedback: The description doesn't clearly separate features from benefits as the prompt requires, and it overstates the evidence: "every hair type" goes beyond the fine and thick hair mentioned in reviews, "many repeat buyers" stretches a few reviews, and "slim design" and "smooth" feel are unsupported by the empty Features field. It also runs about 165 words, short of the ~200 target, and repeats "grooming" and "precise" often.
